name: @magzog/magflip
description: magFlip is a web app that makes it feel like you're flipping through a real book online with smooth page-turning effects.
author: Sing Graajae Cho

scripts.build:local: npm run build:local --workspace packages/doc && npm run build:local --workspace packages/core && npm run build:local --workspace packages/flipview && npm run build:local --workspace packages/scrollview && npm run build:local --workspace packages/minjs
scripts.dev: npm run build:local && npm run serve
scripts.docs:start: npm run build:local && npm start --prefix website
scripts.docs:build: npm run build:local && npm run build --prefix website
